"""Static checks of docker/codex-review/Dockerfile's pins and final-stage contents.

The review image runs Codex against an untrusted (bot/fork) PR head inside a
disposable container (D-07). These tests parse the Dockerfile as text --
no Docker daemon is required -- and pin the properties that make it safe to
use for that purpose: a digest-pinned base, a checksum-verified Codex
binary, and a final stage that contains nothing but the Codex runtime.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from pathlib import Path

from tests import codex_review_run as runner

REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
DOCKERFILE_PATH = REPO_ROOT / "docker" / "codex-review" / "Dockerfile"

_FROM_LINE_RE = re.compile(r"^FROM debian:bookworm-slim@sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}( AS \w+)?$")


def _dockerfile_text() -> str:
    return DOCKERFILE_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8")


def _first_from_start(text: str) -> int:
    match = re.search(r"^FROM ", text, re.MULTILINE)
    assert match is not None, "Dockerfile has no FROM line"
    return match.start()


def _header_comment() -> str:
    text = _dockerfile_text()
    return text[: _first_from_start(text)]


def _final_stage() -> str:
    text = _dockerfile_text()
    from_starts = [m.start() for m in re.finditer(r"^FROM ", text, re.MULTILINE)]
    assert from_starts, "Dockerfile has no FROM line"
    return text[from_starts[-1] :]


def test_from_lines_pin_base_by_digest() -> None:
    text = _dockerfile_text()
    from_lines = [line for line in text.splitlines() if line.startswith("FROM ")]
    assert len(from_lines) == 2, f"expected exactly 2 FROM lines, found {len(from_lines)}"
    for line in from_lines:
        assert _FROM_LINE_RE.match(line), f"FROM line is not a digest-pinned debian:bookworm-slim: {line!r}"


def test_codex_version_and_sha256_are_pinned() -> None:
    text = _dockerfile_text()
    assert "ARG CODEX_VERSION=0.153.4" in text
    assert "ARG CODEX_SHA256_ARM64=5cda6182bd94c3a30f2eb63a495489ebf7f691fddb14d70f48c6c1a5071b6cde" in text


def test_download_url_uses_versioned_release_path() -> None:
    text = _dockerfile_text()
    assert "releases/download/rust-v${CODEX_VERSION}/codex-aarch64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz" in text


def test_fetch_stage_verifies_checksum_before_extracting() -> None:
    text = _dockerfile_text()
    assert text.count("sha256sum -c") == 1
    sha_index = text.index("sha256sum -c")
    tar_index = text.index("tar -xzf")
    assert sha_index < tar_index, "checksum verification must happen before extraction"


def test_final_stage_has_no_extra_tooling() -> None:
    final_stage = _final_stage()
    for token in ("apt-get", "curl", "git", "python", "node", "pip"):
        assert token not in final_stage, f"final stage must not contain {token!r}: {final_stage!r}"


def test_final_stage_copies_codex_binary_and_ca_bundle() -> None:
    """The final stage ships the Codex binary plus the CA bundle the fetch
    stage already resolved -- and nothing else -- so Codex can validate TLS
    to the model backend without any package manager in the final image.
    """
    final_stage = _final_stage()
    copy_lines = [line.strip() for line in final_stage.splitlines() if line.strip().startswith("COPY")]
    assert copy_lines == [
        "COPY --from=fetch /usr/local/bin/codex /usr/local/bin/codex",
        "COPY --from=fetch /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt",
    ]


def test_final_stage_declares_required_runtime_config() -> None:
    final_stage = _final_stage()
    assert "USER 10001:10001" in final_stage
    assert "WORKDIR /work" in final_stage
    assert 'ENTRYPOINT ["codex"]' in final_stage
    assert "HOME=/home/review" in final_stage
    assert "LANG=C.UTF-8" in final_stage
    assert "CODEX_HOME=/codex-home" in final_stage
    assert re.search(
        r'LABEL org\.triggarr\.codex-review="(\$\{CODEX_VERSION\}|0\.153\.4)"',
        final_stage,
    ), "final stage must label the image with the Codex version"


def test_final_stage_declares_no_extra_env_vars() -> None:
    """The ENV instruction must still declare exactly HOME, LANG, CODEX_HOME.

    The CA bundle lands at the Debian-standard /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
    path, which rustls-native-certs' openssl-probe lookup finds on its own --
    no SSL_CERT_FILE is needed, so verify_container_config's CONTAINER_BASE_ENV
    allowlist (PATH, HOME, LANG, CODEX_HOME) never has to grow for this fix.
    """
    final_stage = _final_stage()
    assert "SSL_CERT_FILE" not in final_stage
    env_block = re.search(r"ENV\s+HOME=\S+\s*\\\s*\n\s*LANG=\S+\s*\\\s*\n\s*CODEX_HOME=\S+\s*\n", final_stage)
    assert env_block is not None, "ENV instruction must declare exactly HOME, LANG, CODEX_HOME and nothing else"


def test_final_stage_creates_non_root_review_user() -> None:
    final_stage = _final_stage()
    assert re.search(r"groupadd\s+-g\s+10001\s+review\b", final_stage), "final stage must create group review:10001"
    assert re.search(
        r"useradd\s+-u\s+10001\s+-g\s+10001\b[^\n]*\breview\b", final_stage
    ), "final stage must create user review:10001"


def test_header_comment_documents_digest_pinning_and_sensitivity() -> None:
    header = _header_comment()
    assert "deliberately new" in header
    assert "digest" in header
    assert "sensitive review-machinery change" in header


def test_header_comment_documents_ca_bundle() -> None:
    header = _header_comment()
    assert "CA" in header or "certificate" in header

    text = _dockerfile_text()
    match = re.search(r"ARG CODEX_VERSION=([0-9.]+)", text)
    assert match is not None, "Dockerfile has no ARG CODEX_VERSION="

completion_gate() decides whether a live inspection-only (untrusted-head)
Codex review counts as COMPLETE. It is bound to exactly one attempt's
output prefix -- never a glob over other attempts -- so an earlier failed
attempt for the same head can never block a later COMPLETE one, and a
COMPLETE-looking later attempt can never borrow an earlier attempt's

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from pathlib import Path

from tests import codex_review_run

_GATE_PHASE_DIR = ".planning/phases/x"
_GATE_HEAD = "a" * 40
_GATE_BASE = "b" * 40
_GATE_LABEL = "untrusted-e2e"


def _gate_name(attempt: int) -> str:
    return f"{_GATE_HEAD[:12]}-{_GATE_LABEL}-a{attempt}"


def _gate_prefix(attempt: int) -> Path:
    return Path(f"{_GATE_PHASE_DIR}/codex/{_gate_name(attempt)}")


def _gate_setup(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch) -> Path:
    monkeypatch.setattr(codex_review_run, "REPO_ROOT", tmp_path)
    codex_dir = tmp_path / _GATE_PHASE_DIR / "codex"

    return codex_dir


def _write(codex_dir: Path, name: str, suffix: str, data: object) -> None:
    (codex_dir / f"{name}{suffix}").write_text(json.dumps(data), encoding="utf-8")


def _valid_meta(attempt: int, *, audited_changed: list[str] | None = None) -> dict:
    return {
        "meta_version": 2,
        "head": _GATE_HEAD,
        "base": _GATE_BASE,
        "label": _GATE_LABEL,

def _valid_status(*, complete: bool = True) -> dict:
    return {

        "reasons": [] if complete else ["codex exited 1"],
        "qualified_ids": [],
        "finding_count": 0,

        "base": _GATE_BASE,
        "base_on_main": True,
        "grader_ref": _GATE_BASE,
        "grader_source": "trusted-origin-main",
    }


def _valid_ci_evidence() -> dict:
    ci_ready = {
        "id": 1,
        "name": "CI ready",
        "head_sha": _GATE_HEAD,
        "status": "completed",
        "conclusion": "success",
        "html_url": "https://github.com/thejuran/triggarr/runs/1",
    }
    return {"check_runs": [ci_ready], "ci_ready": ci_ready}


def _write_full_attempt(codex_dir: Path, attempt: int, **overrides: object) -> None:
    """Write a fully valid, internally-bound attempt record set, unless overridden."""
    name = _gate_name(attempt)
    meta = overrides.get("meta", _valid_meta(attempt))
    status = overrides.get("status", _valid_status())
    boundary = overrides.get("boundary", _valid_boundary(attempt))
    provenance = overrides.get("provenance", _valid_provenance())
    ci = overrides.get("ci_evidence", _valid_ci_evidence())
    _write(codex_dir, name, ".meta.json", meta)
    _write(codex_dir, name, ".status.json", status)
    _write(codex_dir, name, ".boundary.json", boundary)
    _write(codex_dir, name, ".grader-provenance.json", provenance)
    _write(codex_dir, name, ".ci-evidence.json", ci)
    if "base_status" in overrides:
        _write(codex_dir, name, ".base-status.json", overrides["base_status"])

    ],

def test_completion_gate_fails_on_non_object_record(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch, capsys, suffix: str, value: object
) -> None:
    """Valid JSON that is not an object never lets a required record's checks be skipped."""
    codex_dir = _gate_setup(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    changed = ["tests/codex_report_status.py"]
    _write_full_attempt(
        codex_dir, 2, meta=_valid_meta(2, audited_changed=changed), base_status=_valid_status()
    )

    _write(codex_dir, _gate_name(2), suffix, value)

    reasons = completion_gate(_gate_prefix(2))

    assert reasons, f"gate passed with {value!r} in {suffix}"
    assert any("JSON object" in r or "not established" in r for r in reasons), reasons
    assert main(["--completion-gate", str(_gate_prefix(2))]) == 3
    capsys.readouterr()
